free_text: Although the patient has a prior diagnosis of ISUP Grade Group 1 carcinoma, the rising PSA velocity of 1.03 ng/mL/yr from 4.6 to 7.7 ng/mL, combined with the PI-RADS 3 finding on MRI, suggests the need for further characterization. The statistical prior suggested no biopsy, but the retrieved PSA trend and the presence of a new lesion on MRI tipped the balance toward re-evaluation. Therefore, a biopsy is recommended to re-evaluate the risk profile given the PSA trajectory.
